title: The Missing Blueprint (Zootopia 2)

vocabUnits.defA2: To come into sight or become visible.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: To come into sight or become visible.

usages.label: 出现
usages.sentence: A rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.
usages.sentenceZh: 雨后天空出现了一道彩虹。
usages.explain: 表示某物突然或逐渐变得可见。
usages.rephrase: After the rain, we saw a rainbow in the sky.

usages.label: 似乎
usages.sentence: She appears to be very happy with her new job.
usages.sentenceZh: 她似乎对新工作很满意。
usages.explain: 表示根据观察得出的印象或判断。
usages.rephrase: It seems that she is very happy with her new job.

usages.label: 出场
usages.sentence: The famous singer will appear on stage at 8 p.m.
usages.sentenceZh: 那位著名歌手将在晚上8点出场。
usages.explain: 指在公共场合或表演中露面。
usages.rephrase: The famous singer will come on stage at 8 p.m.

derivatives.note: 注意前缀dis-表示否定，加上appear（出现）变成“消失”。
derivatives.exampleSentence: The sudden disappearance of the keys worried everyone.
derivatives.exampleZh: 钥匙突然消失让所有人都很担心。

induct.title: 反义词对
induct.tip: appear 的反义词是 disappear，名词形式为 disappearance。

examExamples.readSentence: The disappearance of the old building surprised the whole neighborhood.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 旧建筑的消失让整个社区感到惊讶。

examExamples.readSentence: The police are looking into the disappearance of the valuable painting.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 警方正在调查那幅珍贵画作的失踪事件。

examTarget.note: 考点：appear 的名词派生 disappearance，注意前缀 dis- 和后缀 -ance。

usages.label: 错误的
usages.sentence: I gave the wrong answer in the math test.
usages.sentenceZh: 我在数学考试中给出了错误的答案。
usages.rephrase: My answer in the math test was not correct.

usages.label: 出问题
usages.sentence: Something is wrong with my phone; it won't turn on.
usages.sentenceZh: 我的手机出问题了，它开不了机。
usages.explain: 表示某物功能不正常或存在故障。
usages.rephrase: My phone doesn't work; there is a problem.

usages.label: 不道德
usages.sentence: It is wrong to cheat on an exam.
usages.sentenceZh: 考试作弊是不对的。
usages.rephrase: Cheating on an exam is not right.

derivatives.note: wrongly 是副词，修饰动词，表示“错误地”。
derivatives.exampleSentence: He was wrongly accused of stealing the money.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他被错误地指控偷了钱。

induct.title: 形容词变副词
induct.tip: 多数形容词加 -ly 变成副词，但 wrong 本身也可作副词（非正式）。

examExamples.readSentence: The report wrongly blamed the innocent driver for the accident.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 那份报告错误地将事故归咎于无辜的司机。

examExamples.readSentence: She was wrongly treated because of her accent.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她因为口音而受到错误对待。

examTarget.note: 考点：wrong 的副词形式 wrongly，修饰动词表示方式。

vocabUnits.defA2: Moving or happening at a fast speed.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: Moving or happening at a fast speed.

usages.label: 快速的
usages.sentence: We had a quick lunch before the meeting.
usages.sentenceZh: 我们在会议前快速吃了午餐。
usages.rephrase: We ate lunch fast before the meeting.

usages.label: 敏捷的
usages.sentence: The rabbit is quick to run away from danger.
usages.sentenceZh: 兔子能迅速逃离危险。
usages.rephrase: The rabbit runs away from danger very fast.

usages.label: 立刻的
usages.sentence: Please give me a quick answer.
usages.sentenceZh: 请给我一个快速的答复。
usages.rephrase: Please answer me quickly.

derivatives.note: quicker 是 quick 的比较级，表示“更快的”。
derivatives.exampleSentence: This route is quicker than the one we took yesterday.
derivatives.exampleZh: 这条路线比我们昨天走的那条更快。

induct.title: 形容词比较级
induct.tip: 单音节形容词比较级通常加 -er。

examExamples.readSentence: We need a quicker way to solve this problem.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 我们需要一个更快的办法来解决这个问题。

examExamples.readSentence: She is quicker at learning new words than her brother.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她学新单词比她的弟弟更快。

examTarget.note: 考点：quick 的比较级 quicker，用于两者比较。

vocabUnits.defA2: To separate something into two or more parts.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: To separate something into two or more parts.

usages.label: 分开
usages.sentence: Let's divide the pizza into eight slices.
usages.sentenceZh: 我们把披萨分成八块吧。
usages.rephrase: Let's cut the pizza into eight pieces.

usages.label: 分配
usages.sentence: The teacher divided the students into groups.
usages.sentenceZh: 老师把学生分成小组。
usages.explain: 按一定方式分配人员或资源。
usages.rephrase: The teacher put the students into different groups.

usages.label: 分歧
usages.sentence: Opinions are divided on this issue.
usages.sentenceZh: 在这个问题上意见有分歧。
usages.rephrase: People have different opinions on this issue.

derivatives.note: 被动语态表示“被分成”，注意主语是单数。
derivatives.exampleSentence: The class was divided into two teams for the game.
derivatives.exampleZh: 全班被分成两队进行比赛。

induct.title: 被动语态结构
induct.tip: 被动语态由 be + 过去分词构成，be 动词随主语和时态变化。

examExamples.readSentence: The project was divided into three stages.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 这个项目被分成了三个阶段。

examExamples.readSentence: The land was divided among the farmers.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 土地被分给了农民们。

examTarget.note: 考点：divide 的被动语态 was divided，注意时态和主谓一致。

usages.label: 阻止
usages.sentence: Wearing a seatbelt can prevent injuries in a car accident.
usages.sentenceZh: 系安全带可以防止车祸中的伤害。
usages.explain: 采取措施避免不良后果。
usages.rephrase: Wearing a seatbelt helps stop injuries in a car accident.

usages.label: 预防
usages.sentence: Washing hands often helps prevent the spread of germs.
usages.sentenceZh: 经常洗手有助于预防细菌传播。
usages.rephrase: Washing hands often can stop germs from spreading.

usages.label: 妨碍
usages.sentence: The heavy rain prevented us from going out.
usages.sentenceZh: 大雨阻止了我们外出。
usages.rephrase: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.

derivatives.note: 动词不定式作目的状语，表示“为了阻止”。
derivatives.exampleSentence: He locked the door to prevent anyone from entering.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他锁上门以防止任何人进入。

induct.title: 不定式表目的
induct.tip: 不定式常用来表示做某事的目的，结构为 to + 动词原形。

examExamples.readSentence: She left early to prevent missing the train.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她早早出发以防止错过火车。

examExamples.readSentence: They built a wall to prevent flooding.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他们建了一堵墙以防止洪水。

examTarget.note: 考点：prevent 的不定式形式 to prevent，在句中作目的状语。

vocabUnits.defA2: The physical or mental energy needed to do something.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: The physical or mental energy needed to do something.

usages.label: 努力
usages.sentence: It takes a lot of effort to learn a new language.
usages.sentenceZh: 学习一门新语言需要付出很多努力。
usages.explain: 指为达成目标而付出的精力。
usages.rephrase: Learning a new language requires hard work.

usages.label: 尝试
usages.sentence: She made an effort to be friendly to the new student.
usages.sentenceZh: 她努力对新同学表示友好。
usages.rephrase: She tried to be friendly to the new student.

usages.label: 成果
usages.sentence: His efforts finally paid off when he won the prize.
usages.sentenceZh: 他的努力最终得到了回报，他赢得了奖项。
usages.rephrase: He worked hard and finally won the prize.

derivatives.note: effort 可数名词，复数形式表示多次努力或多方努力。
derivatives.exampleSentence: The team's efforts led to a successful project.
derivatives.exampleZh: 团队的努力促成了项目的成功。

induct.title: 可数名词复数
induct.tip: effort 作为可数名词，复数加 -s，常与 make 搭配。

examExamples.readSentence: All our efforts were wasted because of the storm.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 因为暴风雨，我们所有的努力都白费了。

examExamples.readSentence: She made great efforts to improve her English.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她付出了巨大的努力来提高英语水平。

examTarget.note: 考点：effort 的复数形式 efforts，表示多次或集体努力。

vocabUnits.defA2: Something that is kept hidden or known only by a few people.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: Something that is kept hidden or known only by a few people.

usages.label: 秘密
usages.sentence: Can you keep a secret? I'm planning a surprise party.
usages.sentenceZh: 你能保守秘密吗？我正在计划一个惊喜派对。
usages.rephrase: Don't tell anyone, but I'm planning a surprise party.

usages.label: 秘诀
usages.sentence: The secret to success is hard work.
usages.sentenceZh: 成功的秘诀是努力工作。
usages.explain: 指达成某事的关键方法。
usages.rephrase: To be successful, you need to work hard.

usages.label: 隐秘的
usages.sentence: They met at a secret location.
usages.sentenceZh: 他们在秘密地点见面。
usages.explain: 形容词，表示不为人知的。
usages.rephrase: They met at a place that no one knew about.

derivatives.note: secretly 是副词，表示“秘密地”。
derivatives.exampleSentence: He secretly left the party without saying goodbye.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他悄悄离开了派对，没有道别。

induct.title: 形容词变副词
induct.tip: 以 -et 结尾的形容词，加 -ly 时通常直接加。

examExamples.readSentence: She secretly watched the movie while her parents were out.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她趁父母外出时偷偷看了电影。

examExamples.readSentence: The spy secretly passed the message to his partner.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 间谍秘密地将消息传给了他的搭档。

examTarget.note: 考点：secret 的副词形式 secretly，修饰动词表示方式。

vocabUnits.defA2: During the time that something is happening.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: During the time that something is happening.

usages.label: 当……时
usages.sentence: I listened to music while I was doing my homework.
usages.sentenceZh: 我做作业时听音乐。
usages.explain: 表示两个动作同时发生。
usages.rephrase: I did my homework and listened to music at the same time.

usages.label: 然而
usages.sentence: Some people like summer, while others prefer winter.
usages.sentenceZh: 有些人喜欢夏天，而另一些人更喜欢冬天。
usages.rephrase: Some people like summer, but others like winter better.

usages.label: 一会儿
usages.sentence: Wait here for a while; I'll be back soon.
usages.sentenceZh: 在这儿等一会儿，我很快就回来。
usages.rephrase: Stay here for a short time; I'll come back soon.

examExamples.readSentence: While the parents were talking, the children played in the yard.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 父母谈话时，孩子们在院子里玩耍。

examExamples.readSentence: He likes tea, while his sister likes coffee.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他喜欢茶，而他妹妹喜欢咖啡。

examTarget.note: 考点：while 作为连词，表示时间或对比。

vocabUnits.defA2: To feel sad or sorry about something that happened or you did.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: To feel sad or sorry about something that happened or you did.

usages.label: 后悔
usages.sentence: I regret not studying harder for the exam.
usages.sentenceZh: 我后悔没有为考试更努力地学习。
usages.explain: 对过去的行为感到遗憾。
usages.rephrase: I wish I had studied harder for the exam.

usages.label: 遗憾
usages.sentence: We regret to inform you that the event is canceled.
usages.sentenceZh: 我们遗憾地通知您活动取消了。
usages.rephrase: We are sorry to tell you that the event is canceled.

usages.label: 懊悔
usages.sentence: He regretted his rude words immediately.
usages.sentenceZh: 他立刻对自己粗鲁的话语感到懊悔。
usages.explain: 对刚发生的事感到后悔。
usages.rephrase: He felt sorry for his rude words right away.

derivatives.note: regret 的过去式要双写 t 再加 -ed。
derivatives.exampleSentence: She regretted not taking the opportunity.
derivatives.exampleZh: 她后悔没有抓住那个机会。

induct.title: 重读闭音节双写规则
induct.tip: 以重读闭音节结尾的动词，末尾辅音字母双写再加 -ed。

examExamples.readSentence: He regretted his decision to quit the team.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他后悔退出团队的决定。

examExamples.readSentence: They regretted not listening to the advice.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他们后悔没有听取建议。

examTarget.note: 考点：regret 的过去式 regretted，注意双写 t。

vocabUnits.defA2: Having a value that is good enough for the time, money, or effort spent.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: Having a value that is good enough for the time, money, or effort spent.

usages.label: 值得
usages.sentence: This book is worth reading.
usages.sentenceZh: 这本书值得一读。
usages.rephrase: It is good to read this book.

usages.label: 价值
usages.sentence: The painting is worth a lot of money.
usages.sentenceZh: 这幅画值很多钱。
usages.rephrase: The painting is very expensive.

usages.label: 值得的
usages.sentence: It was a long trip, but it was worth it.
usages.sentenceZh: 旅程很长，但很值得。
usages.rephrase: The trip was long, but we enjoyed it.

examExamples.readSentence: The museum is worth visiting if you have time.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 如果你有时间，这个博物馆值得参观。

examExamples.readSentence: Hard work is always worth the effort.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 努力工作总是值得的。

examTarget.note: 考点：worth 作为形容词，后接名词或动名词，表示“值得”。

vocabUnits.defA2: To create or design something that has not existed before.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: To create or design something that has not existed before.

usages.label: 发明
usages.sentence: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
usages.sentenceZh: 托马斯·爱迪生发明了电灯泡。
usages.rephrase: Thomas Edison made the first light bulb.

usages.label: 编造
usages.sentence: He invented an excuse for being late.
usages.sentenceZh: 他编造了一个迟到的借口。
usages.rephrase: He made up an excuse for being late.

usages.label: 创造
usages.sentence: She invented a new game for the children.
usages.sentenceZh: 她为孩子们发明了一个新游戏。
usages.rephrase: She created a new game for the children.

derivatives.note: invent 的名词形式是 invention，表示“发明物”。
derivatives.exampleSentence: The invention of the internet changed the world.
derivatives.exampleZh: 互联网的发明改变了世界。

induct.title: 动词变名词
induct.tip: 许多动词加 -tion 变成名词。

examExamples.readSentence: Did you know that the microwave was invented by accident?
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 你知道吗，微波炉是偶然被发明的？

examExamples.readSentence: She likes to invent stories for her little sister.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她喜欢为妹妹编故事。

examTarget.note: 干扰项：本题未使用 invent，但作为词汇学习。

vocabUnits.defA2: To keep someone or something safe from harm or danger.
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: To keep someone or something safe from harm or danger.

usages.label: 拯救
usages.sentence: The firefighter saved the child from the burning house.
usages.sentenceZh: 消防员从燃烧的房子里救出了孩子。
usages.rephrase: The firefighter took the child out of the burning house.

usages.label: 节省
usages.sentence: We can save money by turning off the lights.
usages.sentenceZh: 关灯可以省钱。
usages.rephrase: Turning off the lights helps us spend less money.

usages.label: 保留
usages.sentence: Please save a seat for me.
usages.sentenceZh: 请给我留个座位。
usages.rephrase: Please keep a seat for me.

derivatives.note: save 的名词形式是 safety，但更常用 safe 的派生。
derivatives.exampleSentence: The safety of the children is the most important thing.
derivatives.exampleZh: 孩子们的安全是最重要的。

induct.title: 动词与名词
induct.tip: save 的名词常用 safety，但 rescue 也可作名词。

examExamples.readSentence: We should save water by taking shorter showers.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 我们应该通过缩短淋浴时间来节约用水。

examExamples.readSentence: The doctor saved the patient's life.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 医生救了病人的命。

examTarget.note: 干扰项：本题未使用 save，但作为词汇学习。
